description: Fetch metadata for a three.ws avatar (name, GLB model url, owner, visibility) by id or @handle.

id.description: Avatar UUID (from a three.ws avatar URL or get_avatar).

name: get_avatar

id.description: Avatar UUID, or null when the avatar came from a raw model URL.

owner.description: Owning user; omitted when the API response has no user record.

slug.description: URL slug, or null if the avatar has none.

thumbnail.description: Preview/poster image URL, or null if none is published.

visibility.description: Avatar visibility (e.g. "public", "unlisted"), or null if unreported.

title: Get avatar metadata
